gaps: Ca and SiO2 carry '* wird in Ecoinvent nicht bilanziert' and are left out.
The 5 kg/kg SO2 of FGD waste water itself is not booked as a flow; only the dissolved loads of Tab. 9.34 are.
No FGD plant infrastructure and no electricity for the scrubber and fans.
No particulate or SO2 slip emission to air.
The 'REA-Nass Brk-D' column is the lignite variant and is deliberately not used.
